items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves the right exactness of the Chow group sequence of two closed subschemes whose union is the whole scheme, with the first map the difference of the two pushforwards from the scheme theoretic intersection (statement lines 2990-3006, tag 0F94). Surjectivity is a citation, but exactness in the middle requires a real argument: one writes the vanishing sum as a locally finite family of principal divisors, splits that family according to which closed subscheme each integral component lies in, and rearranges the equation so that the two given classes become the two pushforwards of one cycle supported on the intersection. The splitting and rearrangement are the substance, so the claim is H2.
